stable.label: genesis-foundation-materials-0.1-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.6 and Materials Lab 0.1 remain the integrated main baseline. Materials Lab 0.2 cinematic 3D is isolated on genesis-materials-0.2-3d and is not promoted. Overall product remains unverified because live GitHub.io runtime behavior, real WebGPU execution, and real iPhone Safari are not independently verified.

ci.simulation_test: PASS genesis matter 0.6 cooperative self-assembly tests
PASS genesis materials 0.1 granular sand/water tests

materials3d_lab.original_feedback: It looks the same. It is not 3D and it does not look amazing or like Unreal Engine.
materials3d_lab.experiential_failure: Materials Lab 0.1 used a fullscreen-triangle screen-space renderer, so better shading could not create actual perspective/depth/3D world structure.
materials3d_lab.representation: 2.5D x/z heightfield storing rock elevation, sand depth, water depth and moisture, rendered as real 3D geometry.
rendering: animated water normal perturbation and Fresnel-like reflection
acceptance_criteria: older Matter Lab 0.6 regression remains PASS
older Materials Lab 0.1 regression remains PASS
0.2 fixed-seed reference model reproduces the same hash
0.2 stepping conserves sand and water mass within declared floating-point tolerance
water spreads across more heightfield cells
wet cohesive pile retains more height than equivalent dry pile
renderer contains an actual depth buffer and separate terrain/water/grain pipelines
full PR CI passes on the exact candidate head before promotion

active_objective: Prove that Materials Lab 0.2 is a genuinely different 3D product direction rather than another flat shader pass: run its deterministic heightfield fixtures and all preserved regressions in PR CI, then separately compile/render the WebGPU path on a real deployed device before any Unreal-quality claim.
next_gate: Open a PR from genesis-materials-0.2-3d, inspect exact CI logs for Matter 0.6, Materials 0.1 and Materials 0.2, repair only causal failures, and do not promote if main changes or the exact candidate head is not green.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Rendering consumes simulation state and must not secretly become simulation logic
WebGPU rendering does not imply GPU-compute physics
Visible grain sprites must not be described as independently simulated grains
2.5D heightfield geometry must not be described as volumetric 3D granular physics
Phenomenological wet cohesion must not be described as validated capillary/geotechnical physics
Water heightfield flow must not be described as Navier-Stokes/SPH/MPM/FLIP
Matter Lab 0.6 and Materials Lab 0.1 remain recoverable while 0.2 is experimental
Unreal-quality is an experiential target, not a verification status
